# LOKF Enforcer

> Validate the Linked Open Knowledge Format (LOKF) semantic layer on top of OKF v0.2 in Obsidian.

## Agent context

If `.lokf/knowledge/index.md` exists in this repository, read it first - it is a queryable [LOKF](https://lokf.nolan-nichols.com) knowledge bundle with repository-specific context, conventions, and typed relationships that plain prose can't express.
